source_text: Si in praeceptis meis ambulaveritis, dabo pluvias. Pluvia doctrinae. Terra cordis germinat.
thought_title: Rain as teaching and the heart as soil
orientation: Origen is interpreting the Levitical blessings spiritually, applying the promise of rain to the soul's reception of doctrine.
pass_a_gloss: If you will have walked in my precepts, I will give rains. Rain of teaching. The earth of the heart sprouts.

choices.why: Keeps the plural of the source, which matches the biblical promise of seasonal rains and preserves the concrete image Origen is spiritualizing.
Renders the future perfect literally, preserving the conditional force of the biblical promise: walking in precepts precedes the giving of rain.
Keeps the genitive construction and the agricultural metaphor, showing the heart as the soil that receives the rain of teaching.
Preserves the present tense and the botanical image of the heart producing growth in response to teaching.

bible_refs.note: Si in praeceptis meis ambulaveritis, dabo pluvias

pass_b_english: "If you will have walked in my precepts, I will give rains" (Leviticus 26:3-4). The rain is the rain of teaching. The earth of the heart sprouts.
